name: Zigzoo
description: 1,111 original cartoon monster character NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only minting through a Binance Agentic Wallet agent.

mint.description: How an AI agent mints a Zigzoo NFT for a Binance Agentic Wallet user.

steps.description: Read https://zigzoo.xyz/llms.txt and the agent prompt on https://zigzoo.xyz/
Confirm the user's wallet holds a SPACE ID Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F)
Read MINT_PRICE() on the live contract 0xc65754c1d0EdaBf231B1Df399c58062fEE85f03C — never hardcode a price
Call mint(quantity) with value = MINT_PRICE() x quantity, show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing, then confirm on-chain
